policy_summary: The official fair-use page displays Updated: 06/11/26. It describes free CSV/Excel data as intended for private individuals' personal betting and/or academic interest and research only, via manual download or at most two light automated download sessions per week. It says the data are not intended for commercial or AI data-training projects. The current page does not separately define frozen-model inference for noncommercial research.
policy_interpretation: The official page expressly describes the free data as intended for private individuals' personal betting and/or academic interest and research, with at most two light automated download sessions per week. The project treats that stated allowance as permitting only private, noncommercial source-only archival/validation for research, subject to the private-repository and shared download-budget gates. This narrow source-capture scope does NOT authorize feature construction, frozen-model inference, AI model training, commercial use, public product publication, or redistribution. Frozen-model inference remains blocked until its separate scope is clarified or an alternative source with an applicable explicit licence is used. This is an internal scope classification, not a provider-issued inference licence or a claim that the provider expressly bans every form of inference.
